name: cold-email
tagline_zh: 写B2B冷邮件总被已读不回？试试这个技能：它教你用「三句钩子+跟进节奏」让潜在客户主动回复，连沉默的线索都能唤醒。
tagline_en: Tired of cold emails ignored? This skill teaches 3-line hooks + follow-up cadence that get prospects replying.
desc_en: Write B2B cold emails and follow-up sequences that get replies. Use when the user wants to write cold outreach emails, prospecting emails, cold email campaigns, sales development emails, or SDR emails. Also use when the user mentions "cold outreach," "prospecting email," "outbound email," "email to leads," "reach out to prospects," "sales email," "follow-up email sequence," "nobody's replying to m
why_zh: 它把「回复率」当核心指标，用真实案例拆解每个句子，而非空谈模板，比同类更懂SDR的日常。
why_en: Focuses on reply rate with real-case sentence breakdowns, not generic templates—built for SDR daily grind.
